verdict.rationale: The documented publish path deploys only to Figma's own hosting, and a custom domain still sits on that hosting. Nothing in the evidence documents exporting the app or deploying it to an external host or your own infrastructure. A community user had to reverse-engineer the undocumented .make format to extract the code; that is a user-side workaround, not a product capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy the generated app to an external host or my own infrastructure
